# Adobe Stock

> > Adobe Stock provides millions of royalty-free stock photos, videos, graphics, vectors, and templates powered by Generative AI and integrated with Adobe Creative Cloud applications.

Adobe Stock is a comprehensive digital asset marketplace offering both consumer access to creative content and a contributor platform for selling original work. The platform emphasizes AI-powered customization, seamless integration with Adobe Creative Cloud apps like Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro, and curated collections of design trends.

## Key Topics

- Adobe Stock
- Royalty-free images
- Stock videos
- Design templates
- Generative AI
- Adobe Creative Cloud
- Adobe Photoshop
- Adobe Illustrator
- Adobe Premiere Pro
- 4K video
- Creative assets
- Adobe Firefly
- Free trial
- Template library
- IP indemnification

## Core Platform & Access

- [Adobe Stock Homepage](https://stock.adobe.com): Main hub providing access to millions of royalty-free stock photos, videos, graphics, vectors, and design assets.
- [Search & Customize Assets](https://stock.adobe.com/customize): Search and customize millions of royalty-free stock assets with AI-powered tools and editing capabilities.
- [Subscription Plans & Pricing](https://stock.adobe.com/plans): View subscription tiers, pricing options, and free trial offerings to get started with 10 free Stock images.

## Templates & Design Resources

- [Designer Templates](https://stock.adobe.com/templates): Browse artist-designed templates for Adobe Creative Cloud apps including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Premiere Pro.

## Contributor Platform

- [Sell Creative Work](https://contributor.stock.adobe.com): Platform for photographers, illustrators, and designers to sell their original work and earn royalties through Adobe Stock.

## Curated Collections & Trends

- [Creative Trend: All The Feels](https://stock.adobe.com/collections/AN5q7WqrK5sKkEZFHmCSgMAxsaYAcZ7H): Curated collection of inspirational stock assets featuring emotional visual effects and design elements.
- [Creative Trend: Surreal Silliness](https://stock.adobe.com/collections/1usvslHDkJJEfL2t4sbtd6VhqB4ysboK): Curated collection of playful surreal design assets and templates for creative projects.
- [Creative Trend: Local Flavor](https://stock.adobe.com/collections/PkHk8nt17TdwXhjq5pQpiTAr7Vu2HoCm): Curated collection of local culture-inspired design and branding assets for diverse creative applications.
- [Stock Video Footage Collection](https://stock.adobe.com/collections/UUcTLZzjqflZi38Tr6tjCc2py2yjOI2j): Hand-curated collection of professional 4K and HD stock video footage for multimedia projects.
